all.action: Person in dark hoodie and dark pants drops down from fence top on left. Light brown dog stands on right facing fence.
Person lands in a crouch next to fence. Dog stands in yard watching person.
Person stands upright facing dog, arms at sides. Dog remains still watching.
Person raises right hand forward teasing dog. Dog watches alertly.
Person raises both hands and makes sudden feint forward. Dog tenses and prepares to rush.
Dog charges toward person. Person quickly turns left to escape toward fence.
Person jumps and grabs top of fence with hands. Dog rushes to base of fence.
Person scrambles feet against fence boards pulling body upward. Dog snaps upward under person's feet.
Person pulls torso over top of fence. Dog lunges and jumps near fence bottom.
Person swings legs over fence to the other side. Dog stands at base looking up.
Person disappears over fence. Dog turns sideways in yard.
Dog turns around and begins trotting rightward across yard.
Dog walks slowly to the right, tail wagging gently.
Dog strolls across yard underneath fruit tree branches.
Dog continues walking slowly toward right edge of frame.
Dog pauses and looks ahead in yard.

gags.text: the man in the black hoodie climbs over the wooden fence from behind the apple tree and drops into the yard while the Shiba looks up at him
the man bends forward and pats and strokes the Shiba's head; the Shiba leans in and wags its tail, friendly, no barking
the man reaches up with both arms, pulls an apple-laden branch down and picks red apples, tucking them into his hoodie; the Shiba stands beside him watching calmly

gags.en: climbs back out with the apples
gags.text: the man turns, grabs the top of the fence and climbs back over it and out of sight; the Shiba just watches, tail wagging
the Shiba alone sniffs the ground where the man stood, then turns and looks toward the camera, tail wagging as if nothing happened
